mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an easing monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances with FEDFUNDS decline, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 8.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of instances with UNRATE > 8.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate broad-based demand contraction that reduces corporate revenue expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances with both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO) during monetary tightening cycles signals manufacturing slowdowns that reduce corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of instances with INDPRO decline and FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% signals persistent price pressures that may trigger premature monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances with CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 95.0 indicates manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances with INDPRO < 95.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous federal funds rate increases (FEDFUNDS) and consumer spending declines (RSAFS) signal tightening monetary policy reducing disposable income, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances with FEDFUNDS rise and RSAFS decline, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In strong economic expansions (GDPC1 growth >2.0% annualized), declining housing starts (HOUST) signal sector-specific weakness that triggers broader economic slowdown expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of instances with HOUST decline and GDPC1 growth >2.0% annualized, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
